title: Job
description: A model call to make after the request that asked for it (issue #61, ADR 0058): the outbox row of ADR 0039's dispatcher. One per kind and subject, keyed groupedKey(kind, subject_id), so a second request while one is live returns the live one. It holds ids only: the facts are read again when the job runs.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

subject_id.description: What the job is about (a wedding id).

not_before.description: A queued job waits until then (a retry's backoff).

lease_until.description: A running job's claim; after it, the job may run again (a restart mid-call).

last_error.description: The code of the last failure, when it failed.
